question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.team_batting, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker, b.team_batting
) scored
JOIN match m ON scored.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON scored.striker = p.player_id
WHERE scored.total_runs >= 100 AND scored.team_batting != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name
